title: REAP pruning with functional Views for removed experts
hypothesis: After reconstruction-aware pruning retains half of the expert pool, compact Views recover functionally useful pruned experts at lower complete bytes than storing the full bank.
physical_object: eight retained expert matrices chosen as cluster partners
mirror_coordinate: per-pruned-expert coefficient over a shared residual basis
logical_multiplicity: sixteen expert behaviors from eight retained physical experts
controls: REAP-like retained bank with routing to retained partners

development.selection_metric: heldout pruned-expert output nRMSE, actual bytes and reconstruction/inference MAC

fresh.reason: native PCA exact alias is evaluated before fresh access

storage.authority: actual compressed NPZ inference payload bytes

success_gate: Heldout pruned expert nRMSE <=0.02 with >=25% fewer complete bytes than independent experts and lower reconstruction burden than full recovery.
failure_gate: FAIL for Mirror-specific value if native PCA aliases, removed experts are not recoverable, or codes erase pruning savings.
boundaries: Synthetic linear experts and predetermined retained/pruned pairs; no actual REAP importance estimates or MoE task quality.
Pruned experts are generated as partner plus shared residual and private noise.
No claim that reconstructing a pruned expert improves end-task quality.
